inputs.name: falco_version
inputs.description: Falco release to install from Falco's package repository.

inputs.name: hold_package
inputs.description: Hold falco at falco_version, so apt upgrade or dnf upgrade leaves it there: an apt pin on Debian and Ubuntu, a dnf versionlock on Rocky Linux and Fedora. False releases the hold.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.description: Lowest priority of alert Falco logs, from emergency, alert, critical, error, warning, notice, informational and debug. Falco's default, debug, logs every rule that fires.

inputs.name: json_output
inputs.description: Log each alert as a JSON object rather than a line of text, for log shippers.

inputs.name: rules
inputs.description: Falco rules of your own, as YAML, written to /etc/falco/rules.d/conn3x.yaml. They can use the macros and lists in Falco's default rules. Empty removes the file.

inputs.name: rules_updates
inputs.description: Let falcoctl fetch new versions of Falco's default rules every week. When false, the rules stay those that came with falco_version.
